title: 1720 Prairie's porch built to its photograph: paired posts, arches, cresting
items: The Tyrrell/Walker house's porch now stands on paired posts under three shallow arches, as its undated photograph shows, with turned balustrades either side of the stair and raking rails up the stair's sides.
An iron cresting runs round the porch roof's deck, and the porch is a little shorter and taller than before, measured where it stands rather than at the wall behind it.
